name: Windsock the Ginger Tabby Cat
description: Windsock, a ginger tabby with a white chest, white paws and a striped orange tail, sits by the gate to watch which way the wind blows. A cat coin priced in BOEING. Not affiliated with The Boeing Company, Backpack Securities or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
look: A normal four-legged, slim young house cat. Ginger (orange) mackerel tabby with darker orange stripes on the forehead, back, legs and tail, a white chest, belly and four white paws, a pink nose, big pink-lined ears and olive-gold eyes. Wears nothing.
